nesting.answer: An adult chicken that is not, and was not, part of a chicken jockey lays an egg every 5–10 minutes while actively simulated. It does not need another chicken or breeding food to lay that ordinary egg. Chicks do not lay eggs.

housing.answer: A bee nest or beehive can hold up to three bees. Keep its entrance clear so bees can leave. To move the home with its bees, wait until the bees are inside and use Silk Touch; breaking it without Silk Touch releases the bees rather than keeping them inside the dropped home. A lit campfire can prevent harvesting anger, but protect bees from the fire.

item_holding.answer: Endermen can pick up, carry and place selected blocks, such as dirt and sand; they cannot carry every block. The mobGriefing game rule controls their normal block-changing behavior. A carried block is not food, and putting the enderman in a boat does not make it safe from its attacks.

support.answer: An elder guardian applies Mining Fatigue III to nearby Survival players within 50 blocks, even through walls. The effect lasts five minutes and can be applied again while an elder guardian remains nearby. Milk removes it but also removes your beneficial effects. The ghostly screen image is the effect warning, not a separate enemy to kill.

naming.answer: Naming a rabbit Toast gives it the special black-and-white Toast appearance. This changes the name and appearance, not its normal passive behavior. Breeding Toast rabbits does not pass on the Toast appearance; the babies use the parents’ underlying normal colors.

Name a vindicator Johnny, with that spelling and capital J, to make it attack many additional kinds of mob. This does not tame it or make it safe: it remains dangerous to players and can threaten animals and villagers.

infestation.answer: Idle silverfish can enter suitable stone, cobblestone, stone bricks or deepslate and turn them into infested blocks when mobGriefing permits it. They do not infest every stone-looking block: slabs, stairs, granite, diorite, andesite and smooth stone are not substitutes. Silk Touch prevents releasing a silverfish when mining its infested block.

caravan.answer: Leashing one llama can make up to nine nearby llamas follow, for a caravan of up to ten. Each caravan has one leashed leader. Llamas in a caravan cannot breed; separate suitable adults from the caravan before using hay bales for breeding.

breeding_conditions.answer: Use two tamed adult llamas and hay bales. They must not be part of a caravan when breeding. Wheat can help with other feeding uses but does not replace the hay bales that start breeding.

infection.answer: When a zombie, husk, drowned or zombie villager kills a villager, conversion depends on difficulty: Easy 0%, Normal 50%, Hard 100%. The villager must be killed by the appropriate attacker; an ordinary environmental death does not create a zombie villager. A converted zombie villager can later be cured with Weakness and a normal golden apple.

curing.answer: You cannot use the zombie-villager cure on an ordinary zombie, husk or drowned to turn it into a living villager. Weakness followed by a normal golden apple is specifically the cure for a zombie villager.
